evals.prompt: Create a Turnkey sub-organization under my parent org. It should have one root user (with the parent's API key attached) and a default Ethereum wallet. Use env vars TURNKEY_API_PUBLIC_KEY, TURNKEY_API_PRIVATE_KEY, and TURNKEY_ORGANIZATION_ID.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code that initializes a @turnkey/sdk-server client and calls createSubOrganization with subOrganizationName, a single rootUser containing the parent's API key, rootQuorumThreshold of 1, and a wallet with one ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM account at m/44'/60'/0'/0/0. Logs the returned subOrganizationId.

evals.prompt: Provision a Turnkey sub-org with a multi-chain wallet — I need addresses for Ethereum, Solana, and Bitcoin testnet SegWit. Single root user is fine.
evals.expected_output: Code that calls createSubOrganization with one root user and a wallet whose accounts include ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM, ADDRESS_FORMAT_SOLANA, ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_TESTNET_P2WPKH, and ADDRESS_FORMAT_COMPRESSED (the compressed pubkey companion required for Bitcoin signing). Should use @turnkey/sdk-server.

evals.prompt: Create a Turnkey sub-organization but I really don't want to add @turnkey/sdk-server as a dependency — my deployment is bundle-size constrained. Just sign and post the activity directly using node:crypto. Use the parent's P-256 API key from env vars.
evals.expected_output: Code that uses node:crypto (createECDH, createPrivateKey, createSign) to build a P-256 stamp, then POSTs to /public/v1/submit/create_sub_organization with the X-Stamp header. Body is type ACTIVITY_TYPE_CREATE_SUB_ORGANIZATION_V7. Does NOT import @turnkey/sdk-server.

evals.prompt: I need to create a sub-org for a 3-person team. Each member has their own P-256 API key. Set up 2-of-3 root quorum so any two of them can approve sub-org root activities. Include a default Ethereum wallet.
evals.expected_output: Code that creates a sub-org with three root users (each with their own API key), rootQuorumThreshold set to 2, and a wallet with an ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM account.
